question: What is the centered moving average of the customs duty rate imposed on goods subject to duty from FY1939 - 1941 inclusive rounded to the nearest thousandths place?
raw_response:
The three FY rates are ~0.3805, 0.3697, 0.3810. The centered 3-year moving average (centered on FY1940) = 0.377 (or 37.708% if expressed as a percent).

The question says "rounded to the nearest thousandths place." As a rate/proportion that's 0.377. As a percentage it would be 37.708. The rate "imposed on goods subject to duty" is naturally a ratio of duties to value, so 0.377.

The centered moving average of FY1939–1941 inclusive averages all three years = 0.377.

<FINAL_ANSWER>0.377</FINAL_ANSWER>
